title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Fatura & Kaşe. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Fatura & Kaşe
options.lineage: Turkish official paperwork — fatura, seri no, irsaliye, kaşe
options.thesis: Every result shipped as a certified document the owner already trusts: serial, line item, stamp, founder's signature.
options.viewport: The first viewport is the agency's result certificate: serial header, headline as document title, real case numbers as ruled line items, founder signature line, and TEKLİF AL as the one red action stamp.
options.risk: Forms turn dry and bureaucratic the moment the grid loses nerve; the stamps must feel pressed, not pasted.

raised.raise: Tek dokunuş — each viewport commits one full-scale ink gesture, a single decisive stamp impression placed without hedging.
Açık mekanizma — every interaction exposes its working: stamps press under real pressure, perforations tear, pull-tabs slide.

options.label: Hesap Defteri
options.lineage: the esnaf's ruled account book — kasa defteri
options.thesis: The agency keeps your marketing like an honest shopkeeper keeps his book: every lira and every result entered in the grid.
options.viewport: An open defter spread: this month's real results ruled into columns, the founder's entry line at the bottom, the quote action as the next blank row.
options.risk: Warm paper is the fastest way to look trustworthy without proving anything — only structurally real numbers save it; it is also the coziest direction on this table.

options.label: Enstrüman Panosu
options.thesis: The agency as a calibrated instrument: real campaign numbers drive needle ballistics; the only red is past zero.
options.viewport: A shoulder-to-shoulder row of meter faces wired to real stats (150+ proje, +%150 satış), needles settling with true ballistics on load; the quote action rides the red arc.
options.case: Carries 'measured results' literally and beautifully; loses narrowly on identification — a studio instrument is not the owner's daily paper.
options.risk: Reads as audio-culture cosplay unless every needle is genuinely driven by real numbers.

options.label: Ebru
options.thesis: Each campaign a one-contact lift: pigment displaced by gesture, an impression no one can reprint.
options.viewport: A full-bath marbled field; the headline is the single lifted print.
options.case: Fuses poorly: 'an impression that can never be repeated' argues against the product's reportable, repeatable process.
options.kept: Tek dokunuş cesareti — one decisive ink gesture per viewport; rings remember everything.
options.risk: Beauty without a number: trust asserted, never shown.

options.label: Kâğıt Otomata
options.thesis: The client journey as a crank procession — each stage a paper figure that folds open as you advance.
options.viewport: One paper figure mid-motion; the crank line rules the base.
options.case: Fuses poorly: delight without measurement — the process reads as craft, not accountable results.
options.kept: Açık mekanizma — every interaction exposes its working parts; every tab has a job.
options.risk: Charm for the visitor with time; the owner in a hurry wants the number.

canonCard.label: Kategori standardı
canonCard.thesis: What every agency ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Hero, logo marquee, services grid, testimonial carousel — at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
